no_target_yet.statement:
For all fixed real $\alpha,\beta$, as $x\to\infty$,
\begin{equation}
   E(x)\sim \frac{\zeta(2)}2\frac{x}{\log x},
   \qquad E_{\alpha,\beta}(x)\sim\frac{W_{\alpha,\beta}}2\frac{x}{\log x},
   \qquad W_{\alpha,\beta}>0.
\end{equation}
Consequently $E_{\alpha,\beta}(x)/E(x)$ tends to $W_{\alpha,\beta}/\zeta(2)$,
and the ratio for any two fixed pairs tends to $W_{\alpha_1,\beta_1}/W_{\alpha_2,\beta_2}>0$.
no_target_yet.title: Prime-factor densities in Euler forms: a refutation of Zelinsky's Conjecture 1
